shared_elements: rows or registers of small repeated signs
low-relief motifs on a rough grey-tan surface
justification: Both show a tall vertical field of shallow incisions on weathered grey-brown stone, and in each the upper zone carries rows of small repeated sign-like marks above larger forms, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a free-standing three-dimensional anthropomorphic monolith with bold curvilinear relief motifs (rings, scrolls, a prominent disc), while B is a flat rock-cut wall panel dominated by dense horizontal lines of fine linear text with almost no modelled relief.
